title: Decatron
heroDescription: The most complete Twitch bot to automate your channel.
featureCommandsDescription: Create custom commands with dynamic variables, cooldowns, and role-based permissions. Supports counters, aliases, and conditional responses.
featureModerationDescription: Protect your chat with spam, link, and banned word filters. Set up automatic warnings, timeouts, and bans with fully customizable rules.
featureSettingsDescription: Adjust every detail of the bot from an intuitive web panel. Control prefixes, language, active modules, and per-channel behavior without touching code.
featureMultiChannelDescription: Manage multiple Twitch channels from a single account. Each channel has its own independent configuration for commands, moderation, and responses.
featureStatsDescription: View real-time channel metrics: most used commands, active users, chat history, and activity trends displayed in clear charts.
featurePerformanceDescription: Millisecond responses powered by an optimized architecture. The bot stays stable 24/7 with no interruptions or lag in your chat.
featureAIDescription: Smart responses powered by Gemini and OpenRouter. The bot can chat, answer questions, and generate content directly in your stream chat.
featureOverlaysDescription: OBS overlays with alerts, goals, and on-screen chat. Customize colors, animations, and position to integrate them seamlessly into your stream.
whyFreeDescription: No paid plans, no locked features. Every feature is available to all users from day one.
whyCustomDescription: Every module can be tailored to your style. From commands to moderation, everything is configurable from the web panel with no hassle.
whyLangDescription: Support for English and Spanish with more languages on the way. Being implemented gradually to cover more communities.
ctaDescription: Decatron is an independent, free project. Your support helps keep the servers running and fund the development of new features.

hero.title: Hear your favorite streamer in your language
hero.text: A Chrome extension that dubs the stream in real time, and only you hear it. The channel, the chat and everyone else stay exactly the same.
hero.note: Free for viewers. No account. Only asks for permission on twitch.tv.

demo.caption: The 🌐 button shows up next to the player's gear when the channel offers translation.

install.title: Install the extension
install.text: It's added to Chrome and only acts on twitch.tv. No account, no data.

pick.title: Pick your language in the player
pick.text: If the channel offers translation you'll see a 🌐 button next to the gear. Pick English, Portuguese or whatever the streamer offers.

listen.title: Listen and read
listen.text: The translated voice plays over the original voice at a lower volume, with captions. You can adjust the background volume and the delay.

private.title: Only you hear it
private.text: The translation plays in your browser. The streamer doesn't change anything in the broadcast and other viewers don't notice.

captions.title: With captions
captions.text: Each phrase shows up in text at the pace of the audio; the original too, if you want.

noaccount.title: No account, no tracking
noaccount.text: There's no sign-up. Your preferences (language, volume) live in your own Chrome.

streamers.title: Are you a streamer?
streamers.text: Turn on live translation from your Decatron dashboard, install the desktop app that captures your microphone and pick the languages. Viewers from other countries hear you in theirs.

privacy.title: Extension privacy
points: The extension only runs on twitch.tv pages and only talks to decatron.net.
It asks for no account and collects no personal data. It doesn't read the chat or your Twitch activity.
The only thing sent to the server is the name of the channel you're watching and the language you picked, to receive that channel's translation.
Your preferences (preferred language, background volume, captions) are stored in your browser and are removed by uninstalling the extension.
The translated audio and text are generated from the streamer's voice, with their explicit authorization when enabling the feature.
